text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival.
To entertain their fans, the Umamusume will take on a variety of events!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...I believe I have made every possible preparation for this day."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of yielding the top.
Please bear witness as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Verxina strides forth courageously.
Toward the battlefield she chose—!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The "Supreme Big Sister Championship" to crown the number-one big sister! The competition... starts nooow!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaaaah, Big Sis!"
"Do your best, Verxina-san~!"
"Hayahide! You're the one true big sister!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-chan, Hayahide-chan,
Journey-san, Ramonu-san.
...Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then!
The challenge my big sisters will take on is... this!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, make it your little sister.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's to completely charm Golshi-chan on the
special stage with big sister power!
choice_data_list: Make Gold Ship head over heels...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's reckless"... The thought immediately crosses my mind.
That Umamusume, Gold Ship, is supposed to be
completely unhinged and chaotic, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Entry number 1.
Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, filleting in three pieces versus two!
What's the big difference anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, they're not the same.
Filleting into two leaves the backbone attached to one side...
...All right, I'll explain it one more time.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Hayahide-san.
You seem to be struggling quite a bit."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "However, the resolve to patiently face things head-on—that, too, is a skill born of big sister power."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. It looks like the older girls are plotting their strategy while waiting in line. Now then, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —What a pain.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Ramonu-san made her move!
What's going to happen!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you ready for this?
You're rockin' some frills just like Mac-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Quietly.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Kooo...h?!

text_block_list.name: Big Sister Connoisseur
text_block_list.text:
—!? T-This is... the intimidating older sister!
Commanding obedience purely with dignity... what terrifying big sister power...!
choice_data_list: (There's even people here who look like judges)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! A huge lead with just a single word!
Does this decide who's the number one big sister?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, oh my. ...Dear me.
...This won't do.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san, over here. Tell me everything
you want done, won't you?
Everything will be just as you desire."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Apyaa... Journey...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, now Journey-san enters the fray!
Will the super-sweet pampering skills she honed with Orfe-chan activate now~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now, as the final contestant, how will
little Verxina play her hand, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Of course.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I shall claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it.
—...Golshi-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~, what a cute big sister smile!
Could even Golshi-chan be knocked out by this~?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's up, fellow classmate?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh! Golshi's whim has activated!
Ignoring the lore and being completely direct with her classmate!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...... It's fine.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I know. I'll play along.
...She is at that age, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~!?
'At that age'...? It's nothing like thaaat~~!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Verxina adapted so flexibly!
She played off the other girl's prickly attitude and framed it as a "rebellious little sister and big sister" dynamic!

text_block_list.name: Big Sister Connoisseur
text_block_list.text:
"'Titles do not threaten the bond of sisters'—magnificent!
Only an older sister with absolute faith in her younger sister could give such a reply...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-You big jerk!!
Someone like her isn't my big sis at all, hmph!

text_block_list.name: Voice from Above
text_block_list.text: —Verxina, out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aaand, too bad! Golshi-chan's big sister energy was way too strong, and she got way too into character!
She said the exact opposite of being lovey-dovey, so she's disqualified~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Please wait!
My big sister power still has plenty left in the tank—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, without being able to demonstrate her usual big sister prowess,
Verxina's battle for the title of big sister
came to an end...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. I'll make sure to call you
Golshi-san in front of your friends too."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...
What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's fine.
...I'll just stay Golshi-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Even Golshi-chan got totally immersed playing the little sister! It's a huge comeback victory for Verxina-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My! ...Hehe, thank you,
Golshi-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The victory gong echoed out.
On this day, Verxina climbed yet another step higher as a big sister...
